+0xA8 was declared as a pointer (damage_pending). It is a byte: the index of the moby's pending hit in the level's 64-entry hit table, 0xFF for none, as damage_queue_add (func_L01_00446A70, matched) reads and writes it.

pullRequests.author: DrLegitamate
pullRequests.head: match/fabs-asm
pullRequests.body:
Summary
These are three near misses where the only difference was where abs.s is scheduled. __builtin_fabsf is an ordinary insn that the scheduler places by latency. Retail's abs.s is scheduled as an asm, which is how include/vu0.h documents fabs_asm(), the game's fabs. With fabs_asm, each one matches:
